variants.name: Normal Knight
variants.author: Toby Fox
variants.desc: The Roaring Knight fight exactly as#it plays in DELTARUNE Chapter 3.
variants.diff: Standard: the fight exactly as shipped.
mech: Vanilla Roaring Knight fight.
Uses the game's normal phases and final roar sequence.
Weird Route (hub): halfway through the attack list the Knight takes one member (never the last one standing); the others react and the Knight hits 25% harder.
Credits: Toby Fox.
variants.party: Any party. Kris, Susie and Ralsei are the intended party; other parties are code-audited, not played.
variants.prac: Practice: a named attack picker (Phase and Turn) added by this hub, modelled on Kaizo's. The Knight and your party can't be defeated; end-attack button and HoldBreath toggle included. Attacks listed after a phase's last turn are marked (unused). Not part of the original mod and not tested in the real game.
variants.title: NORMAL KNIGHT

variants.name: Kaizo Knight
variants.author: EnderCat8 & TheCyVap
variants.desc: A much harder remix: new attacks,#a guard to break and a Side B.
variants.diff: Unrated. A remix of the base fight with new attacks.
mech: New attack patterns, gloom meter and Side B phases.
Weird Route (Side B) with any party: Kris has an X-Slash ACT; without Kris, Susie's Rude Buster does that job.
Has its own Practice choice in the intro.
Creator not specified in the supplied files.
variants.party: Any party with a leader in slot 1. Party order is kept. Weird Route works with any party.
variants.prac: Practice: the mod's own attack-practice menu, shown at the start of the fight.
variants.title: KAIZO KNIGHT

variants.name: Violet Knight
variants.author: Looks to the Moonlight
variants.desc: 20+ new attacks, and a stranger#Side B on Weird Route saves.
variants.diff: Unrated. Builds on Kaizo Knight's code.
mech: Violet-themed attacks and tension changes.

Weird Route with any party: with Kris, Ralsei (else the Angel) is lost, then Susie, and Kris ends it with X-Slash. Without Kris the Knight takes the Angel first (Ralsei: 'this wasn't in the prophecy'), then Ralsei; Susie (else Ralsei, else Noelle) gets a power-up scene and ends it with Rude Buster / FireShock / SnowGrave.
Creator not specified in the supplied files.
variants.party: Any party. Weird Route works with every party; who is lost and who finishes depends on who is there.
variants.prac: Practice: a named attack picker (Phase and Turn) added by this hub, modelled on Kaizo's. The Knight and your party can't be defeated; end-attack button and HoldBreath toggle included. With Weird Route on it lists the Weird Route attacks (their own names). Attacks listed after a phase's last turn are marked (unused). Not part of the original mod and not tested in the real game.
